browser: Codex In-app Browser with CDP device metrics
method: Loaded each local demo page in the browser, set a temporary viewport override, read document and embedded object geometry through CDP, checked embedded SVG text font sizes, and cleared the override after the run.

gantt.note: The 12px floor belongs to the compact print variant; executive and delivery variants measured 14px.

page_level_document_scroll_width.detail: Each page reported document.scrollWidth equal to the active viewport width.

embedded_content_width.detail: Responsive forms fit the content box; dense forms keep their natural width inside an explicit internal scroll region.

manual_visual_checks.result: The narrow page retains the reading controls, a named scroll region, a readable 14px quality report and links for SVG, draw.io and JSON; the map is intentionally wider than the viewport and scrolls inside its frame.
The page exposes a detailed natural-size mode and a fit-width overview mode; switching to fit-width keeps the complete overview inside the page without document overflow.
Bar, line, donut and heatmap sections show explicit units/labels and scrollable reading containers; the line chart was inspected after scrolling to its full plotting region.

scope: This closes responsive embedded coverage for nine popular cross-industry demo pages. It does not certify the remaining demo pages, arbitrary high-density user inputs, domain facts, aesthetics, native-editor behavior, or JEV review.
